Instructions · tap a title to open it
Your work saves by itself in this browser. Every slot below is a button on the main menu (☰).
Quick start
  1. Make assets: draw a picture and tap Save asset. The Presets row adds ready-made shapes and body parts (circle, star, heart, head, body, arm, leg, hand, foot, eye and more). They come in your current Fill and Outline colors, and you can recolor and reshape them before saving.
  2. Edit video: tap the asset to put it on the frame, then drag it where you want it.
  3. Add a frame with + Keyframe (copy), move things a little, and repeat.
  4. Watch video plays it. Export or Zipper saves it.
▶ Watch video
  • Preview your animation on the playback screen.
  • Use the flag button to mark the current playback position, and the stop button to stop playback.
  • Use Edit video to make changes, then return here to watch the updated animation.
📖 Instructions
  • This page explains the studio's menu slots and how their tools work.
  • Tap a section title to expand or collapse its instructions. Use the Quick start section for the basic animation workflow.
🆕 What's New
  • Opens the studio's PenguinMod project in a new browser tab.
  • Use it to visit the linked project and see its PenguinMod page.
🧹 Polisher (Cleaner)
  • The Polisher lists what can be tidied: unused assets, blank frames at the end, stray specks in drawings, wobbly positions, broken effects and silent audio.
  • Tap the Clean button on a line to fix just that, or Clean everything. Undo last clean puts everything back.
🎞 Frame by frame audio (deleted slot)
  • This slot was deleted. It isn’t in the menu anymore. It’s listed here so you remember it existed.
  • It let you put each sound in its own box, give it a frame to start on and a frame to end on, and step through the animation hearing just that frame.
  • You can still place sounds on frames in the Audio slot: upload as many as you like, and set Starts at frame and Ends at frame (decimals work).
🎭 Voiceover effects
  • Record or upload a voice, pick a style (Robot, Deep, Chipmunk, Monster, Alien, Telephone, Megaphone, Echo, Cave, Underwater) and a strength.
  • Preview plays it. Apply to track changes the clip, Apply as new track keeps the original too, Revert undoes it.
🔗 Upload by link
  • Paste a link to a picture, a sound or a project file and tap Load link.
  • Browsers only let this page read links from sites that allow it, so many links are refused. If that happens, download the file and use Upload instead.
  • Below that, Go to a website opens YouTube, YouTube Studio, popular video making programs or any web address in a new tab.
🖼 Image editor
  • Choose an SVG or picture that holds lots of sprites. Pick Grid (columns and rows), Find sprites (finds each separate drawing) or Draw boxes (drag your own).
  • Tap a box to switch it off or on. Add as assets puts the chosen sprites in your assets. Make frames puts one sprite on each frame, starting at your current frame, so a sheet becomes an animation.
🦴 Rigs (characters)
  • Build a cartoon character: pick colours, hair, eyes and mouth. Drag the blue dots to bend its arms, legs, body and head, and the red dot to move it.
  • Tap Idle, Wave, Point, Cheer, Jump, Walk, Run to load a ready-made pose. Save pose keeps your own.
  • Walk, Run, Wave, Cheer, Jump under Make it move build the animation for you on the frames from your current frame on. Make frames from my saved poses fills in the steps between your own poses.
  • Draw your own head in Make assets, then pick it with Use as head.
  • Tool strip: the strip on the left is your toolbox. Pieces and Bones switch what the big button does, Poses loads and saves poses, Animate makes the movie, and Editor holds colours, body parts and the number options. Tap a tool again to close it. The green ＋ makes another blank character.
  • Make your own character: Bones are the structure and Pieces are the skin. In Bones, tap ＋ LINE and drag for a thin line (arms, legs, neck, tail), or tap ● DOT and tap the stage for a massive dot (head, body); drag out from where you tap to make it bigger. Start a new line on a dot or on another line and it joins it. Drag a blue dot to bend a bone. Then tap Pieces: tap a bone's blue dot to pick it, tap ＋ ADD PIECE and pick a shape or a drawing, and the skin lands on that bone and moves with it. You can also drag a piece onto any bone. ⤢ Fit to bone sizes it to the bone. ＋ Look (or several looks drawn into one asset in Make assets) gives a piece another picture (a different face, say): tap the piece to switch to the next look, and in Edit video pick the look for each frame under the character. A horse: one big dot for the body, a dot for the head, lines for four legs, a neck and a tail.
  • Bones: tap a blue dot to pick a bone (it turns pink). New bone lets you drag out your own bones, starting on a dot or on any bone. Attach picture ties one of your assets to the picked bone so it moves with it. Invisible bone hides the stick so only the picture shows.
🏞 Scenery & props
  • Tap a background to put it on your Background layer, on this frame, from here on, or on every frame.
  • Tap a prop (tree, house, car, ball and more) to add it to your assets and put it on this frame.
✎ Edit video
  • ➤ Select: tap an asset to pick it. Drag to move. Use the corner dots to resize, the side dots to stretch one way, and the top dot to rotate.
  • Stretch mode: On / Off (under the sliders): when it is On, the picked asset shows a yellow dot on each corner. Drag a corner to move just that corner, so the asset changes shape. Tween glides the shape too. A corner can't cross over the others, so the shape stays four-sided. While an asset is bent, use the Size slider to resize it. Reset stretch puts the width, height and corners back.
  • Tween: On / Off (next to Onion), for each frame by itself. A frame with Tween on glides its assets smoothly toward where they are on the next frame, over the time of that frame (so it follows your FPS) when you press Play, Watch or Export. Frames in between that you haven't made yet get filled in too. A blue T marks frames that have it on. Undo tween takes the last fill back. Only assets tween, not drawings.
  • ✏️ Pencil draws, 🪣 Fill fills a closed drawing or repaints a colored part, 🧽 Eraser rubs out. The color button spins a rainbow when no tool is using color.
  • On: Frame / Stage chooses whether you draw on this frame or on the background that stays on every frame.
  • Timeline: ⏮ ‹ ▶ › ⏭ move through frames. Onion shows the last frame faintly. FPS is the speed.
  • Layers: the top of the list is in front. 👁 hides a layer.
  • Properties: size, rotate, stretch width / height and text for the picked asset. ↶ ↷ undo and redo.
✍ Edit text
  • Shows the text on the frame you are on (the layer you picked in Edit). Step with ‹ › to change frame.
  • + Add text puts it in the middle. Tap a text in the list, or tap it on the picture and drag to move it.
  • Change what it says, the size, the turn, the outline and how see-through it is. Pick its color, outline color and font. Bold, Italic and the left / middle / right buttons work too.
  • The strip under the picture shows every frame (tap one to go there). Tween: On / Off works for text too: with it on, move or restyle a text on a later frame and it glides there, size and color included.
  • Font: pick one from the list. Fonts you add in the 🔤 Fonts slot show up here.
  • Copy makes another one beside it. Delete removes the picked text. Text in Edit still works, and shows here too.
🎥 Edit camera
  • Each frame can have its own camera: the part of the picture the video shows.
  • Drag the yellow box to move it. Drag a corner or a side to resize it in any direction (a different shape stretches the picture). Lock shape keeps the shape.
  • The Turn slider tilts the camera (−180° to 180°) around its center, so you can spin the whole picture. Straighten sets the tilt back to 0°.
  • A frame with no camera of its own keeps the camera of the frame before it.
  • The Edit screen always shows the whole picture; Watch, Effects and exports use the camera.
✚ Make assets
  • Draw with shapes, brush, text and more. Fill and Outline can be a color or a gradient (up to down, left to right, radial, or custom). Tap the gradient bar to add a color and drag the dots to move them.
  • Upload adds a picture or an SVG. SVGs stay sharp.
  • Convert to Bitmap turns shapes into pixels, so you can paint and erase on them.
  • Name it and tap Save asset: it goes on this frame and into your backpack.
☁ Imagination
  • You float up into the clouds (tap to skip), and then there is an empty sky to draw your idea on.
  • Tap the 💡 button to capture your idea: it drops into the row of ideas under the sky and the sky clears for the next one. Tap an idea to bring it back and keep drawing (what you were drawing is captured first). The small ✕ on an idea deletes it.
  • The only tools are the pen, which follows your finger or mouse, and the round color button in the corner. Tap it, tap a color, and keep drawing. Start over in that box clears the sky.
  • Your drawing and captured ideas are kept in this browser.
🔤 Fonts
  • Every font is shown in its own look, using the sample words at the top. The six original fonts are named as the font itself (Device Font and Device Typewriter use whatever your device normally uses, so they look a little different on each device), and every well-known font your device has is listed too (a font your device doesn't have isn't shown).
  • Import font files takes font files (.ttf, .otf, .woff, .woff2) and .zip files that have font files inside, and you can pick several at once. Imported fonts are saved with the project.
  • Use on text puts that font on the text you picked in Edit text. Remove takes an imported font out of the list; any text that used it shows in a plain font.
✨ Effects
  • Pick a layer (or the whole picture), choose an effect, set From frame and To frame, then + Add.
  • Blur, Glow, Shake, Tint, Sunshine, Fade in / out, Wipe in / out, Zoom in / out.
🎙 Audio
  • ● Record voice or Upload audio. Each sound has a Starts at frame box and a Volume slider.
  • ▶ Play from start plays the video with its sound.
🏷 Naming & more
  • Project name (used in file names), who made it, and notes for your own plan.
  • Rename any layer or asset.
🔄 Converter
  • Choose a .webm video and select Convert to MP4 to make an .mp4 copy.
  • The converted video appears in the preview area when conversion is available.
🤐 Zipper
  • Pack the project, video, GIF, frames, assets, sound (if any) and an info.txt file into one .zip archive.
  • You can also open a .zip archive and load a project from it.
⬇ Export
  • Save the video as .webm or .mp4, save the project (.json), open a project, or copy it as text.
🎛 Menu customizer
  • Change the menu title, how many buttons sit in a row (1, 2 or 3) and how big the buttons are.
  • For each slot: pick an icon, type a new name, choose a color, hide it, or move it up and down. The Menu customizer itself can never be hidden, so you can always get back.
  • Reset the menu to normal undoes all of it. Your choices are kept in this browser.
⚙ Settings
  • Video speed (FPS) and the canvas size. With Scale the project to fit on, everything is scaled with the canvas.
  • Arrange slots on the main menu moves slots around. The reset button in Settings puts them back in color order.

Zipper · pack your whole project into one .zip file
Every zip holds:
  • project.json · the current animation project
  • info.txt · notes & credits, layers & frames, every name and your settings, all in one text file
  • video.mp4 · the current video
  • animation.gif · the project as a gif
  • assets/ · every asset as a picture (assets that came from an SVG stay SVG)
  • sound/ · your sound files, only if there is sound
  • Flamey's Animation Studio.html · a free copy of the studio (the newest one from the website) that works with no internet
